description: A red plume with a pale shaft, bright as a warning. Whatever wears these does not need camouflage.
lore: Red carries at dusk and does not rot, so for a long stretch of years the east road was marked with these: one plume in the verge every hundred paces, on the side that was safe. Somebody walked it twice a year and re-planted the ones the ground had moved. That was a job, with a name and a rota, and it lapsed. The plumes are still out there, most of them, still red, and about a third of them are now on the wrong side. [[characters/7a779de1|Wendell]] can tell you which third, if you sit with him long enough.
gm_notes: A lapsed rota that is now actively dangerous, and the elder who is its last index. Sitting with Wendell is the price of the information, and that is the point.
